title: Unit command
what: The bmo-pocket command bmo dispatches to: its registry verbs put, take, list and mcp, its tool nouns list, describe, call and sites, and the nouns it declares. docs/api.md states its words and exit codes.

title: Published clients
what: The Rust crate bmo-pocket-client and the TypeScript package @bmo/pocket-client: one call per route over the control socket, the wire types, the harness plugin's fixed tools and the OpenAPI document they are generated from. docs/api.md states this boundary.

title: mcp-host command
what: The mcp-host command verbs: serve, the host itself on the loopback port and the control socket, and call, one call of one placed tool as a session would make it without a host running. docs/api.md states the call verb.

title: Control socket API
what: Every route the host answers over its Unix control socket, grouped by resource: health, namespaces, tools, tool calls, claims, tool sessions and schedules, with their status codes and error bodies. docs/api.md states them and docs/openapi.json carries them.

title: Harness plugin tools
what: The MCP server bmo-pocket mcp serves on standard input and output: the four fixed tools pocket_namespaces, pocket_tools, pocket_tool and pocket_call, and every hosted tool under its namespace's name. docs/api.md states them.

title: Tool contract
what: The bmo-tool crate and the call protocol every placed tool speaks: the tool.toml manifest, the object handed on standard input, the call-back socket, the session record and the answer shape. docs/api.md states it and sdk/contract realises it.

title: MCP tools face
what: The streamable HTTP MCP servers on the loopback port: one path for every namespace a placed manifest declares, and one for the toolbook, each request standing alone behind a tool session bearer token. docs/api.md states this face.
